data.raw_text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY
PROJECTS COMMISSIONING/FLAG-OFF IN THE FCT
Day 12 - Friday, 27th June, 2025

Commissioning of the newly constructed Kabusa - Ketti Road at the Ketti village primary school.

This is to again inform the FCT motoring public, especially those plying the Apo mechanic village route and the Kabusa village area, that vehicular traffic will be slightly slower during the movement of dignitaries/ invited guests to the venue of the commissioning.

The Mango tree junction and the Okada junction at Kabusa noted for traffic bottlenecks will be manned by security agents and traffic control personnel to remove all encumbrances that will impede traffic flow and at some point closed to allow for easy passage of dignitaries/ invited guests.

Also all junctions along the entire route from Apo - Kabusa village will experience the presence of personnel to stop and pass traffic intermittently.

Your cooperation is again solicited.

Signed
Head Traffic, DRTS
